sheet_prompt:
One illustration of 9 separate characters arranged in 3 rows of 3, evenly spaced across a single seamless background.
Subject: original generic emojis colorful.
Style: glossy 3D render, smooth rounded shapes, shiny plastic-like material, soft studio lighting with bright reflections.
Outline: none. Draw every character directly on the background with no outline, border, stroke, die-cut edge or halo around it.
Reading left to right, top to bottom, every character shows a different emotion on the same face: only the expression changes, so no two characters share the same eyes, eyebrows or mouth:
Character 1: thinking hard, eyes glancing up and to the side, one eyebrow raised
Character 2: confused with a tilted head, crooked brow and sideways glance
Character 3: rolling eyes with a bored deadpan face
Character 4: disbelief with squeezed-shut eyes and a deep sigh
Character 5: clueless sideways glance with a crooked half-smile
Character 6: bored with half-lowered eyelids and a flat unimpressed mouth
Character 7: wearing sunglasses, smirking, ultra cool
Character 8: proud smug grin with a confident raised brow
Character 9: scheming grin with wiggling eyebrows
Make every expression big and readable at small size: exaggerated eyes, eyebrows and mouth. Faces only: never a body, arms, hands, legs, feet, ears, tails or props.
Consistency: the same character design, proportions and colours for all 9 characters.
Background: a single, seamless, solid pure green (#00FF00) background covering the whole image in exactly one shade, with no tiled panels, no shading variations, no tint, gradient, vignette or glow, no shadows, no floor, no noise.
Spacing: every character is the face and head alone, large and centred, with a generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of its own size), clearly separated from the others, none touching or crossing another.
video_prompt:
Animate this 3x3 sheet of emojis as a 3-second clip.
Create a very expressive animation of each emoji, each having its own personality with a wide range of emotions.
1. eyes glance up, the brow furrows then lifts, a slow nod
2. the head tilts, one brow lifts, eyes glance aside
3. eyes circle slowly, head tilts back with a sigh
4. eyes squeeze shut, the head shakes slowly, deep sigh
5. glances side to side, the half-smile tilts, head tilts
6. eyelids droop, the mouth stays flat, slow exhale
7. slow confident head nod, the sunglasses glint
8. the smug grin spreads, the brow lifts, confident nod
9. eyebrows wiggle, the grin widens, sneaky giggle
Each emoji moves only inside its own cell. Empty cells stay empty. Static camera.
Keep the flat green background and every emoji's design unchanged. Faces only: no bodies, no hands.
